title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 1: Foundations, Final Accounts & Records - Financial Accounting - Provision for discounts
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 1: Foundations, Final Accounts & Records
subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: When calculating the provision for discount allowable on debtors, the percentage is applied to the debtors' balance
options: Before deducting both bad debts and provision for doubtful debts
After deducting bad debts but before provision for doubtful debts
After deducting both bad debts and provision for doubtful debts
Based strictly on the gross credit sales of the year
questions.explain:
A business only expects to give cash discounts to *good* debtors who actually pay on time. Therefore, to calculate the Provision for Discount Allowable, you must first remove debtors who definitely won't pay (bad debts) and debtors who might not pay (provision for doubtful debts).

The calculation order is: **Gross Debtors - Bad Debts - Provision for Doubtful Debts = Good Debtors**. The discount percentage is applied to this final good debtors figure.
